ndd96f60830.headline: Petrol price increases, diesel on a downturn
ndd96f60830.summary: The Department of Petroleum and Mineral Resources announced that petrol will rise by R1.43 this Wednesday. Diesel, paraffin and LP gas prices will decrease.
ndd96f60830.why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport, logistics and inflation, which affect consumer spending and central bank policy in South Africa.

n10f0480343.headline: UK manufacturing growth strikes four-year high despite rising inflation
n10f0480343.summary: UK manufacturing growth reached a four-year high, higher than analysts expected and the initial flash estimate of 53.7 reported late last month.
n10f0480343.why: Manufacturing purchasing managers' indices are closely watched gauges of the UK industrial economy and inform Bank of England rate expectations.

n1b84eaab23.headline: Ukraine’s MHP buys majority stake in poultry producer Nitsiakos
n1b84eaab23.summary: Ukrainian food group MHP said in a stock exchange filing that it will acquire 70% of Nitsiakos in three stages.
n1b84eaab23.why: MHP is one of Europe's largest poultry producers, and acquisitions like this expand its footprint in European meat markets.

n904858e22d.headline: Bulgaria emphasizes significance of green energy corridor project with Azerbaijan (Exclusive)
n904858e22d.summary: Bulgaria's Deputy Energy Minister said the green energy corridor project between Azerbaijan and Bulgaria is an important initiative for the participating countries.
n904858e22d.why: Energy corridors link power and renewables networks across borders, affecting regional energy security and investment in clean generation.

nc131da21fa.headline: Sensex, Nifty extend losses as Middle East tensions fuel market uncertainty
nc131da21fa.summary: Sensex and Nifty recorded a fourth straight daily decline, led by selling in FMCG, financial and auto stocks. The fall was attributed to Middle East tensions, uncertainty over the US-Iran ceasefire and elevated crude prices.
nc131da21fa.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indices for Indian equities, tracking large companies listed on the BSE and NSE. Crude oil prices heavily influence India's import bill.
nc131da21fa.why_moved: Fresh Middle East tensions, uncertainty over the US-Iran 60-day ceasefire and elevated crude prices drove selling in FMCG, financial and auto stocks.

n4d22bb661b.headline: SOCAR and Shell explore cooperation opportunities
n4d22bb661b.summary: Cooperation opportunities between SOCAR and Shell have been considered, a SOCAR source told Trend. The discussion took place at a meeting involving SOCAR President Rovshan Najaf.
n4d22bb661b.why: SOCAR is Azerbaijan's state oil company, and Shell is a global integrated oil major, so partnerships between them can affect upstream and downstream energy projects.

n854f12023c.headline: SOCAR, ExxonMobil Corporation brainstorm work progress on MoU signed in 2025
n854f12023c.summary: Work carried out under a memorandum of understanding signed between SOCAR and ExxonMobil last year has been discussed, a SOCAR source told Trend. No further terms were disclosed.
n854f12023c.why: ExxonMobil is a major US-listed oil and gas producer, and its partnerships in Azerbaijan can affect its international project pipeline.

nfe35fb62c5.headline: Iran threatens retaliation over US blockade as Israel warns of Beirut strikes
nfe35fb62c5.summary: Iran vowed to resist a US blockade and asserted control over the Strait of Hormuz. Netanyahu signaled military action against Hezbollah in Beirut.
nfe35fb62c5.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so threats to shipping there move energy prices and risk premia.
nfe35fb62c5.why_moved: Iran's vows to resist the US blockade and assert control over the Strait of Hormuz raise the risk of disruption to oil shipping, which typically lifts crude prices.

n24a5e041f3.headline: Bitcoin Stays Steered by Iran Nerves as BTC Price Drops Under $73,000
n24a5e041f3.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $73,000 at the start of the week. Macro forces are competing with doubts about whether the bear-market bottom has been reached.
n24a5e041f3.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price is often used as a barometer of risk appetite in digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The article reports bitcoin trading below $73,000 at the start of the week.

n24a5e041f3.why_moved: Macro forces and Iran-related tensions weighed on bitcoin, while doubts about whether a bear-market bottom has formed added to selling pressure.

n7062bdd1b9.headline: US says it struck Iranian military sites, Tehran responds with air base attack
n7062bdd1b9.summary: The US said it struck Iranian military sites, eliminating air defences, a ground control station and two drones. Tehran responded with an air base attack as negotiations to end the war dragged on.
n7062bdd1b9.why: Strikes between the US and Iran raise the risk of disruption to Gulf oil shipping and regional supply.
n7062bdd1b9.why_moved: Direct military exchanges between the US and Iran while negotiations stall raise fears of wider conflict in the region.

nf2f6cf7376.headline: Major Crypto Exchange Coinbase Enables Rupee Bank Rails in India
nf2f6cf7376.summary: Coinbase has launched direct rupee bank transfers in India via IMPS, letting users deposit and withdraw rupees alongside spot and perpetual futures trading.
nf2f6cf7376.why: Coinbase is a large US-based cryptocurrency exchange, and fiat on- and off-ramps determine how easily customers can move money in and out of crypto.

n0c4a3a6dd3.headline: Iran halts talks with U.S. over Israeli actions in Lebanon, Gaza
n0c4a3a6dd3.summary: Iran has halted talks with the US over Israeli operations in southern Lebanon and Gaza. Trump said Israel and Hezbollah would stop fighting after the move.
n0c4a3a6dd3.why: US-Iran tensions affect oil supply risk, since the Middle East supplies a large share of global crude.
n0c4a3a6dd3.why_moved: The halt in US-Iran talks adds geopolitical risk in the Middle East, a key oil-producing region. The input does not give a market reaction.

nbf90856cb5.headline: Binance Launches Tokenized US Equities with 24/5 Trading
nbf90856cb5.summary: Binance has launched commission-free trading for 7,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs, including 24/5 tokenized equities trading. The move is part of crypto platforms' push toward broader 'super app' offerings.
nbf90856cb5.why: Binance is one of the largest global cryptocurrency exchanges. Expansion into tokenized equities brings traditional securities trading into crypto platforms, a growing competitive trend.

ncb6b55d78f.headline: U.S. bombs Iranian military sites, then downs missiles Tehran fired at troops in Kuwait
ncb6b55d78f.summary: The US says it bombed radar and drone sites in Iran after Tehran shot down an American drone. Iran then said it targeted US soldiers in Kuwait with missiles, which the US says it intercepted.
ncb6b55d78f.why: Military escalation involving Iran affects Gulf shipping routes, oil supply risk and regional security costs.
ncb6b55d78f.why_moved: Strikes and missile fire involving Iran and US forces in the Gulf raise the risk of disruption to regional oil flows, which typically lifts crude prices.

n71476c5f61.headline: China issues new rules to bust ‘ghost’ takeout deliveries
n71476c5f61.summary: China has issued new rules targeting 'ghost' merchants that operate takeout delivery from residential buildings. Such operators are accused of unsanitary conditions.
n71476c5f61.why: Food delivery platforms are major consumer internet businesses in China, and tighter merchant rules affect platform operations and compliance costs.

n87a19eddd9.headline: Iran Says the Strait of Hormuz Will Stay Closed. What Happens to the US Economy Next?
n87a19eddd9.summary: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed. Economists differ on how fuel shortages from the oil supply shock may affect US growth and inflation.
n87a19eddd9.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key route for global oil and LNG shipments, so closures affect energy prices, inflation and growth worldwide.
n87a19eddd9.why_moved: A continued closure of the Strait of Hormuz threatens a large share of seaborne oil flows, which directly raises the risk of supply shortages and higher crude prices.

n73cd55965c.headline: International ATF prices cut 27%; commercial LPG, 5-kg cylinder prices raised
n73cd55965c.summary: India cut Aviation Turbine Fuel prices for international airlines by 27% on easing global fuel benchmarks. Commercial LPG and 5-kg cylinder prices were raised to record highs.
n73cd55965c.why: Aviation turbine fuel and LPG are refined petroleum products whose prices feed directly into airline costs and household energy budgets in India.

n4fd1c84a6f.headline: ICICI Bank Demands Rs 100 Crore from Fintechs for Alleged Merchant Misclassification
n4fd1c84a6f.summary: ICICI Bank is seeking recoveries of at least ₹100 crore from fintech firms, alleging merchant misclassification of their business that has eroded the bank's revenue.
n4fd1c84a6f.why: ICICI Bank is one of India's largest private lenders, and disputes with fintech partners affect payments revenue and regulatory scrutiny in the sector.

impacts.name: ICICI Bank
impacts.why: The bank is the party seeking recoveries from fintech firms over alleged merchant misclassification.

n85285aa5fb.headline: Sensex Falls Over 500 Points, FMCG And PSU Bank Stocks Lead Broad Market Decline
n85285aa5fb.summary: The Sensex fell 508 points and the Nifty slipped below 23,400 on Monday. Weakness in FMCG, PSU banking, auto and realty stocks weighed on sentiment, as investors awaited domestic data and RBI policy decisions.
n85285aa5fb.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark equity index, tracking 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
n85285aa5fb.why_moved: Losses in FMCG, PSU banking, auto and realty stocks drove the decline, with investors also tracking global developments and awaiting domestic economic data and RBI policy decisions.

n3b26c439b4.headline: Inflation At 300% And Stock Markets Plunging: True Cost Of Pakistan
n3b26c439b4.summary: Pakistan is launching a plan to build its first strategic oil reserve by redirecting fuel tax revenue. The aim is to shield the economy from Middle East war shocks and secure energy supply lines amid high inflation.
n3b26c439b4.why: Strategic oil reserves buffer importing countries against supply shocks, which matters for their inflation, currency and fiscal position.

n1fd9b595ee.headline: Good news for diabetes & BP patients: Govt cuts prices of these 30 medicines, relief may reach pharmacies soon
n1fd9b595ee.summary: India's National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority has fixed retail prices for 30 essential drug formulations, including those for diabetes, heart disease and infections. Benefits are expected to reach consumers in two to three months.
n1fd9b595ee.why: The NPPA is India's drug price regulator, which caps prices on essential medicines under the Drugs Prices Control Order. Its decisions directly affect pharmaceutical company revenues in the domestic market.

nbdcad785b1.headline: The Billion Dollar Oil Question: What Comes Next?
nbdcad785b1.summary: A commentary says the Strait of Hormuz may not fully reopen until 2027, and that demand rebound from China and India could strain inventories. It describes inventory systems running low.
nbdcad785b1.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint through which a large share of global seaborne oil passes. Disruptions there directly affect crude prices and global energy supply.

n247c797d8a.headline: Oil prices rise, but not by enough to keep Wall Street from more records
n247c797d8a.summary: Oil prices rose Monday after fighting threatened the US-Iran ceasefire. The S&P 500 added 0.3% to a new all-time high as Wall Street showed little concern.
n247c797d8a.why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, so Middle East supply risks feed directly into energy costs and inflation expectations. The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is a key gauge of US equity performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index added 0.3% to a new all-time high despite the oil rise.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n247c797d8a.why_moved: Renewed fighting threatened the US-Iran ceasefire and lifted oil prices, but investors appeared unconcerned, and the S&P 500 still set a record.

n6d2483941d.headline: Nvidia launches new chip to bring AI directly to personal computers
n6d2483941d.summary: Nvidia has unveiled a new chip that puts AI capabilities directly into laptops and desktop computers. The product pits Nvidia against AMD, Intel and Apple.
n6d2483941d.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips for data centres. Expansion into PC chips extends its reach into the consumer and enterprise computing market.

n0ca67c714a.headline: SK hynix workers to seek Samsung-level housing loans
n0ca67c714a.summary: SK hynix is expected to open its 2026 wage negotiations this month. Employees are pressing the company to match housing loans offered by rival Samsung Electronics.
n0ca67c714a.why: SK hynix is a major South Korean memory chip maker, and labor talks can affect its costs and output.

n5b5d72ac4d.headline: S. Korea, African foreign ministers launch first ministerial meeting amid global uncertainty
n5b5d72ac4d.summary: South Korea hosted its first ministerial meeting with representatives of 50 African nations on Monday. Seoul is seeking to strengthen ties amid global uncertainty.
n5b5d72ac4d.why: Africa is a growing market for trade, mining and infrastructure investment, and diplomatic ties often precede commercial deals.

n700b4e36e5.headline: Philippine factory activity returns to growth in May, PMI shows
n700b4e36e5.summary: Philippine factory activity rebounded in May as stronger domestic demand lifted output and new orders. Supply chain disruptions and rising costs linked to the Middle East conflict continued to weigh on manufacturers, S&P Global said.
n700b4e36e5.why: The manufacturing PMI is a closely watched gauge of industrial health, and it shapes expectations for growth and central bank policy.

n5260cae469.headline: BSP eyes stronger response vs inflation
n5260cae469.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas said on Monday it may consider a stronger monetary policy response if inflation pressures persist. The statement came from the central bank in Manila.
n5260cae469.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the Philippine policy rate, which influences local bond yields, the peso and borrowing costs.

nc0d9fd7762.headline: SC upholds Semirara tax perks on oil imports
nc0d9fd7762.summary: The Supreme Court upheld the tax-exempt status of Semirara Mining and Power Corp. on fuel imports. The ruling affects the company's tax treatment on oil imports in the Philippines.
nc0d9fd7762.why: Semirara is a Philippine coal and power company, and tax treatment on fuel imports affects its costs and margins.

n537fc0d29d.headline: Bay Area office vacancies near 40% amid market slowdown
n537fc0d29d.summary: Nearly 40% of office space in the Bay Area remained vacant in the first quarter. The report links the vacancy level to continued weakness amid a market slowdown.
n537fc0d29d.why: High office vacancy rates weigh on commercial property values, landlord revenue and the lending exposure of banks and real estate investors.

n67d3259168.headline: San Miguel seeks approval for P30-billion preferred share offer
n67d3259168.summary: San Miguel Corp. has filed a registration statement for a P30-billion preferred share offering. The company plans to use the proceeds to refinance debt.
n67d3259168.why: San Miguel is one of the Philippines' largest conglomerates, with interests across food, beverages, energy and infrastructure. Its capital raises shape its leverage and funding costs.

nd798ed7f40.headline: UnionBank looking to raise up to P30 billion via approved bond issue
nd798ed7f40.summary: UnionBank of the Philippines plans to raise up to P30 billion through a peso-denominated bond issuance. The bank has an approved bond issue.
nd798ed7f40.why: UnionBank is a major Philippine universal bank, and its bond sales fund lending and manage its balance sheet. Bond issuance also reflects local rate conditions.

n008c455756.headline: Philippines moves to build strategic petroleum reserves
n008c455756.summary: The Philippines is moving to build strategic petroleum reserves amid high fuel costs. Pump prices are set to change this week, according to the report.
n008c455756.why: Strategic petroleum reserves buffer an import-dependent economy against oil supply shocks. Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs and inflation.

n0d1f63560d.headline: GCCs drive shift in outsourcing office demand
n0d1f63560d.summary: The Philippine outsourcing sector is shifting away from large-scale BPO hubs toward smaller offices. GCCs are driving the change in outsourcing office demand.
n0d1f63560d.why: The Philippines is a major hub for business process outsourcing, and changes in office demand affect commercial real estate and employment in the sector.
